LLMDEX General Consensus v1.formula: 0.5 * AA matched-universe percentile + 0.5 * LLMStats General matched-universe percentile
LLMDEX General Consensus v1.missing_data: No score is assigned unless both source observations and an approved family match exist.

LLMDEX Coding Consensus v1.formula: 0.5 * AA official Coding Index matched-universe percentile + 0.5 * LLMStats Coding matched-universe percentile
LLMDEX Coding Consensus v1.missing_data: Unavailable unless both directly comparable source indices exist.

LLMDEX Value v2.formula: 50% performance + 30% cost + 20% speed; missing speed is proportionally redistributed
LLMDEX Value v2.eligibility: Valid performance and blended token price are required.
LLMDEX Value v2.missing_data: Missing price produces no composite score or Value rank.

LLMDEX Efficiency v2.formula: Performance divided by blended cost, percentile-normalized within the eligible population
LLMDEX Efficiency v2.eligibility: Valid price and adjusted performance of at least 25 are required.
LLMDEX Efficiency v2.missing_data: Ineligible models have no Efficiency score or rank and do not affect percentiles.
